text:
cecilia: quick follow-up from today's all-hands — thanks everyone. A couple of product-level timeline clarifications i'd love from leadership: 1) For API: is GA still targeted for end of Q2 or shifted? 2) Console: is feature-parity plan blocking Optimize rollout? 3) Optimize: are the initial cost-savings knobs going to be in Hosted or Dedicated first? TL;DR: need a concrete order and any hard deps. cc @sam @michael :eyes:

michael: short answers — API GA is on track for 6/30 (end of Q2). Console parity items are a rolling set; they do NOT block Optimize initial rollout. Optimize phase 1 (batching suggestions + quantization profiles) ships to Hosted first, Dedicated afterwards. I'll follow up with a tiny doc + owners. :ship::tada:

sam: adding a little color — Console parity work (metrics export, per-route dashboards, and UX polish) is targeted for end of Q3. Those are mostly UX/observability items, not runtime blockers. Optimize phase 1 scope = batching config UI, model recommendation hints, and load test harness. Dedicated delivery depends on billing + quota integration.

rina: engineering note — yep, Dedicated billing hook is the primary dependency. If product wants faster Dedicated onramp we can reduce scope for phase 1 (e.g., ship read-only recommendations first). @alex can confirm infra time. :thinking_face:

alex: infra estimate — wiring billing + quota APIs: ~3w serial, ~2w if we parallelize with a small SC. Testing + rollout: +1w. Perf tuning for quantized kernels could add another ~2w in the worst case (depends on model set). Flags: cross-team validation and infra quotas are the risky bits.

sam: quick action items I'm taking:
```
- update roadmap board with concrete dates (EOD)
- add owners for API GA, Console parity, Optimize phase 1
- create a tiny dependency tracker (billing, kernels, UX)
```

sam: also — doing a short sync with eng & infra tomorrow to triage risks. Cecilia, want a 10:00am slot?

cecilia: yes 10:00am works for me. please put on my calendar and include a 15-min pre-read (one slide). thanks! :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy reminder — infra/staging cluster will run migration job at 03:00 UTC tomorrow. Heads up for testing windows.

rina: noted. i'll make sure load tests avoid that window.

cecilia: perfect. leaving this thread open for any last-minute clarifications — otherwise i'll expect the updated board link in this thread by EOD. :eyes:
